solidworks_insert_lofted_ref_surface.doc: Create a lofted reference surface from profiles that are already selected. Writes a surface feature into the active part and does not save the document; select the profiles with selection mark 1 and in the order you want them lofted. The call returns void, so success is judged by the feature tree gaining a feature.

params.closed: Whether to close the loft; a closed loft needs at least three profiles. Defaults to false.
params.keep_tangency: Whether to keep tangency where the section curves are tangent. Defaults to true.
params.force_non_rational: Whether to force a non-rational surface. Defaults to false.
params.tess_tolerance_factor: Tessellation tolerance factor for a centerline loft; 0.0 uses the default. Defaults to 0.0.
params.start_matching_type: Tangency matching type for the start profile; the official page gives no value table, so it is passed through as an integer. Defaults to 0.
params.end_matching_type: Tangency matching type for the end profile, passed through the same way as start_matching_type. Defaults to 0.

solidworks_assembly_sequence_report.doc: Report the assembly components as ordered rows that read like an assembly instruction sheet. Read-only; it is built from the real bills-of-materials rows, and SolidWorks has no member that produces an assembly sequence.

params.include_excluded: Whether to include components excluded from the bill of materials. Defaults to false.
